ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (concentrated at distal tips and along the water line) to low-intensity dark pixels across the main fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patches located at the left and right distal tips; significant white mottling and highlight splash along the inferior boundary at the water interface; uniform dark pigmentation across the central and medial lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible obtuse V-shaped central notch with a shallow vertical pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge boundary featuring low-amplitude serrations; high-amplitude jagged indentations are present at the far-left and far-right distal terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped lobe curvature exhibiting concavity near the notch, transitioning to convexity through the mid-lobe, and ending in an upward concave sweep at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three discrete, vertical high-contrast linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible on the left lobe, positioned approximately one-third of the distance from the left edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch/tissue loss on the superior trailing edge of the right distal tip; jagged, non-uniform profile of the left distal tip.
